steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setUiMode?.('pro'); s.reresolveFeatureFlags?.(); s.setFloorPlanEditing(true); })()

steps.name: baseline-area
steps.eval: (() => { const p = window.__store.getState().floorPlan; const xs = p.walls.flatMap(w => [w.start[0], w.end[0]]); const zs = p.walls.flatMap(w => [w.start[1], w.end[1]]); window.__area0 = (Math.max(...xs) - Math.min(...xs)) * (Math.max(...zs) - Math.min(...zs)); })()

steps.name: open-menu
steps.eval: (() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Plan ▾'); if (!b) throw new Error('no Plan menu'); b.click(); })()

steps.name: open-scale
steps.eval: (() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('.plan-menu-panel button')].find(b => /Scale plan/i.test(b.textContent)); if (!b) throw new Error('no Scale plan entry'); b.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-valid-default
steps.eval: (() => { const inp = document.querySelector('input[aria-label="Scale factor"]'); if (!inp) throw new Error('no factor input'); if (inp.validity.stepMismatch) throw new Error('default value still stepMismatch'); if (inp.value !== '2') throw new Error('default not 2: ' + inp.value); return 'default 2 is valid'; })()

steps.name: submit-default
steps.eval: (() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button[type="submit"]')].find(b => !b.disabled); if (!b) throw new Error('no enabled submit'); b.click(); })()

steps.name: scaled
steps.eval: (() => { const p = window.__store.getState().floorPlan; const xs = p.walls.flatMap(w => [w.start[0], w.end[0]]); const zs = p.walls.flatMap(w => [w.start[1], w.end[1]]); const area = (Math.max(...xs) - Math.min(...xs)) * (Math.max(...zs) - Math.min(...zs)); const ratio = area / window.__area0; if (Math.abs(ratio - 4) > 0.05) throw new Error('area ratio not ~4 (factor 2^2): ' + ratio.toFixed(3)); return 'scaled x' + ratio.toFixed(2); })()

steps.name: reverted
steps.eval: (() => { const p = window.__store.getState().floorPlan; const xs = p.walls.flatMap(w => [w.start[0], w.end[0]]); const zs = p.walls.flatMap(w => [w.start[1], w.end[1]]); const area = (Math.max(...xs) - Math.min(...xs)) * (Math.max(...zs) - Math.min(...zs)); if (Math.abs(area - window.__area0) > 0.01) throw new Error('undo did not revert'); return 'reverted'; })()
